senses.gloss:
ज्यैष्ठः N. of a lunar month in which the full moon stands in the
 constellation {@ज्येष्ठा@} (corresponding to May-June).

ज्यैष्ठिनेय a. Born from the eldest or principal wife; कृते
 कनिष्ठिनेयस्य ज्यैष्ठिनेयं विवासितम् Bk. 5. 84.

—1 Precedence, priority of birth, primogeniture, seniority.
—2 Pre-eminence, sovereignty.
